# Galaxy source documentation

Start with AGENTS.md and docs/README.md. Current work is in WORK_STATUS.md.
Read relevant topics for the task; originals are consulted only when provenance is needed.
Public documentation and open-source information: docs/public/README.md and docs/technical/source-and-licensing.md.
AI reading entry: docs/public/ai-reading.md. This source repository is the canonical public repository; no separate public mirror is maintained.
